messages:
Priya (PM): quick sync — draft PRD for chat/completions acceptance criteria is up. need scope decisions before i send to legal/customer-suc. TL;DR: deterministic flag, streaming fallback, truncation policy, and integration test matrix. :eyes:
Marco (Eng): linking the doc? can you paste the short list here so we can triage?
Priya (PM): pasted below — please react with :+1: for must-have or :thinking: for later. will take votes by EOD.
Priya (PM): MUST-HAVES:
- 'deterministic=true' produces stable outputs across identical inputs and model variant for supported models (determinism contract)
- streaming fallback: when model variant streaming fails, fallback to chunked non-streaming with progress tokens
- default truncation: keep last 8k tokens of convo if input over limit, with configurable policy per-route
- 95th percentile latency target for chat-completions (8k context) <= 120ms for dedicated tier; hosted SLOs documented
- E2E smoke tests + sample prompts from two paying customers included in CI
Priya (PM): NICE-TO-HAVES:
- per-user token budget enforcement with soft-fail warning header
- prompt-injection detection heuristic for system prompt overrides
- deterministic sampling options beyond top-k/top-p (seeded sampling)

Marco (Eng): quick notes:
- determinism: for quantized variants we need to be explicit about nondeterministic ops (e.g., fused kernels). we can guarantee pseudo-determinism if we freeze RNG + kernel selection, but need a compatibility matrix
- streaming fallback implementation: agree with chunked fallback, but need to specify how the client resumes — will attach a resumable 'progress_token' protocol (simple opaque string).
- truncation: we prefer configurable policy: keep-last (default), keep-first, smart-snippet (later). keep-last is easiest.
Ben (SRE): latency SLO looks aggressive for some dedup/kv-cache miss patterns. can we add 'best-effort 95th <= 120ms, documented exceptions for cold-kv-cache and cross-region fallback'?
Priya (PM): ok adding exception clause: "exceptions: cold-KV-cache miss, cross-region fallback, model-variant fallbacks; those must be documented and monitored"
Alice (Design): client-facing behavior: how should streaming fallback surface? want a consistent UX for partial content + progress indicator. propose: show partial tokens and a small banner "continuing in non-stream mode". also include a standard error code in the response header x-rw-fallback: streaming->nonstream
Jamie (DevEx): SDK impact: we'll expose two flags: deterministic (bool) and resume_token (string). also add an event hook for fallback so customers can instrument. need acceptance tests in both Python and Node SDKs.
Priya (PM): acceptance criteria draft (please push edits):
- API contract: documented fields for deterministic and resume_token, examples for streaming->nonstream fallback
- Unit tests: core runtime unit tests for deterministic runs across 3 model variants (fp16, int8, int4)
- Integration tests: end-to-end convo tests including long prompt (>12k), multi-language prompt (en+jp), and function-calling sequence recovery
- Observability: metrics emitted for fallback_count, deterministic_confidence (label), truncation_applied boolean; dashboard tile in Console
- Customer signoffs: at least 2 paying customers validate sample prompts in staging

Marco (Eng): edge cases I want called out in PRD text:
- mixed-encoding inputs (utf-8 + null bytes) -> runtime should sanitize and return 400 with error code "invalid-input-encoding"
- extremely long system prompts > 50k chars -> reject with explicit guidance and a link to best practices
- function-calling with truncated context -> fallback to 'function-only' mode where only last N turns considered; must warn in response header
- concurrency: deterministic=true + batching -> ensure per-request seed isolation, no cross-request cache bleed

Priya (PM): good. Ben, can SRE add the monitoring playbook line items?
Ben (SRE): will add alert recipes: high fallback rate (>1% of requests in a minute), determinism-flip events (same request diverging), and kv-cache-warmup failures. will also note runbook for rolling back the deterministic flag for a model variant.
deploy-bot: build 8942 for feature/chat-deterministic passed unit tests, queued for staging deploy.
Jamie (DevEx): once in staging i will run SDK smoke tests. tagging @Marco for runtime perf validation and @Alice for UX review in staging.
Priya (PM): decision needed: do we ship deterministic=true only on Dedicated at GA, and enable hosted with a disclaimer? thoughts now so i can lock wording for marketing/legal.
Marco (Eng): preference: GA on Dedicated first. hosted needs more kernel compatibility testing. we can do opt-in hosted beta behind feature flag.
Ben (SRE): agree with Dedicated-first. hosted beta behind flag + telemetry to detect diverging outputs.
Alice (Design): fine. communicate clearly in Console and in API docs that deterministic is beta on hosted. add label "hosted-beta" in UI when enabled.
Priya (PM): ok vote record: Dedicated-first + hosted opt-in beta. i'll update PRD and send to legal/customer-suc. thank you all — please add any quick comments inline in the doc by 5pm PT. :pray:
Marco (Eng): small followup: can we add one explicit example in the PRD that shows streaming fallback headers + sample resume_token? i'll drop a gist in the doc.
Priya (PM): perfect, please do. closing thread for now.
